'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]], [[Israel–United States relations]]
****[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] meets with [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] amidst a second phase of negotiations for the [[ceasefire]] on the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/02/04/nx-s1-5287012/trump-netanyahu-ceasefire-gaza (NPR)]
****U.S. President Donald Trump announces a plan where the U.S. would seek "long-term ownership" of Gaza, and that the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] would be in charge of Gaza's redevelopment into “The Riviera of the Middle East” for "the world's people." Trump also says [[Palestinians]] will have no choice but to leave the territory. [https://www.reuters.com/world/trump-netanyahu-set-pivotal-talks-middle-east-agenda-2025-02-04/ (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2025/feb/04/benjamin-netanyahu-donald-trump-israel-gaza-middle-east-ceasefire-latest-live-news (''The Guardian'')] [https://apnews.com/article/trump-netanyahu-washington-ceasefire-1c8deec4dd46177e08e07d669d595ed3 (AP)]
***[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Gaza war]]
****Two [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] are killed and eight others are injured in a shooting at the Taysir [[Israeli checkpoint|checkpoint]] by an unknown gunman. [https://www.dw.com/en/west-bank-2-israeli-soldiers-killed-in-checkpoint-shooting/a-71501421 (DW)]
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|War in Somalia]]
***[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
****[[Puntland Security Force|Puntland Security Forces]] battle [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|ISIL]] militants near Dharin, killing at least 40 fighters and injuring others. They claim to have captured the village of Dharin in Togga Jecel of [[Bari Region]], [[Puntland]]. [https://thesomalidigest.com/puntland-forces-seize-strategic-town-in-decisive-blow-to-isis/ (The Somali Digest)] [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-puntland-forces-eliminate-20-foreign-isis-fighters-in-major-operation (Garowe Online)]
***[[Jubaland crisis]]
****[[Jubaland Dervish Force|Jubaland forces]] have regained control of [[Bardhere District]] in the [[Gedo]] region after withdrawal of [[Somali National Army|federal forces]] was reportedly linked to the disbandment of units stationed at headquarters for several months. [[Somalia|South Somalia]] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200109/jubbaland_forces_retake_bardhere_district_headquarters_after_federal_troops_withdraw.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine|Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
****A [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missile strikes a residential building in [[Izium]], [[Kharkiv Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], killing four people and injuring twenty others. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/02/4/7496676/ (Ukrainska Pravda)]
***[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[President of Ukraine|Ukraine President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] says in an interview with British journalist [[Piers Morgan]] that he is ready for direct talks with [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] if it is a setup to end the war. [https://kyivindependent.com/i-consider-him-an-enemy-zelensky-says-hes-ready-to-sit-opposite-putin-in-peace-talks/ (Kyiv Independent)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023-present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023-present)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***Engineers in [[Khartoum]] are attacked by the [[Rapid Support Forces]] while assessing damage on a water plant in [[Khartoum North]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article296958/ (Sudan Tribune)]
***Six people are killed and 38 others are injured after an attack perpetrated by the [[Rapid Support Forces|RSF]] hits a hospital in Khartoum. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/6-killed-in-rapid-support-forces-shelling-on-khartoum-hospital/3471656# (Anadolu Ajansi)]
***The [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] take [[Al Kamlin District|Al-Kamlin]] as they advance towards Khartoum. [https://sudantribune.com/article296955/ (Sudan Tribune)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**A series of shootouts and encounters are reported in [[Nuevo Laredo]], [[Tamaulipas]], [[Mexico]], after the arrest of the regional leader of the [[Cártel del Noreste]] and leader of an armed wing in the state. The [[Embassy of the United States, Mexico City|United States Consulate in Mexico]] issues an alert for its citizens to not go out on the streets, and the [[Nuevo Laredo International Airport]] suspends activities due to the violence. [https://www.unotv.com/estados/tamaulipas/reportan-balaceras-en-nuevo-laredo-tamaulipas-consulado-de-ee-uu-lanza-alerta/ (UNO TV)]
**A riot within the Tabasco Social Reinsertion Center in [[Villahermosa]], [[Tabasco]], Mexico, leaves seven inmates dead. This is the second riot in less than two months at the prison. [https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/suman-4-actos-violentos-en-penales-de-tabasco-durante-gobierno-de-javier-may-este-martes-murieron-7-reos-tras-motin-en-creset/ (''El Universal'')]
*[[Ethiopian civil conflict (2018–present)|Spillover of the Ethiopian civil war]]
**[[Djibouti Armed Forces|Djiboutian armed forces]] execute a [[drone strike]] near the [[Djibouti–Ethiopia border|Ethiopian border]], killing eight members of what the government described as a "terrorist group" involved in "hostile actions". The attack also injured an unknown number of civilians. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200102/djibouti_drone_strike_kills_at_least_8_near_ethiopian_border.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]  [https://www.voanews.com/a/djibouti-drone-strike-kills-at-least-8-near-ethiopian-border/7961331.html (VOA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Potomac River mid-air collision]]
**The remains of all 67 people who were killed in a [[Mid-air collision|collision]] between a [[PSA Airlines]] [[Bombardier CRJ700 series|CRJ700]] and a [[United States Army]] [[Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk|UH-60 Black Hawk]] are recovered from the [[Potomac River]] near [[Washington, D.C.]], United States. [https://apnews.com/article/washington-plane-crash-helicopter-recovery-7f492db9e867af2e184d621f56cbc4f6 (AP)]
*[[Azerbaijan Airlines Flight 8243]]
**An [[Government of Azerbaijan|Azerbaijani government]] source reports that the [[Azerbaijan Airlines]] [[Embraer E-Jet family#E190|E190]] plane was shot down by [[Russia]]'s [[Pantsir missile system]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/azerbaijani-plane-that-crashed-december-was-hit-by-russian-pantsir-s-missile-2025-02-04/ (Reuters)]
*Eight people are killed and eleven injured after a truck crashed into a queue of cars at a toll booth in [[Ciawi]], [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.tempo.co/hukum/kecelakaan-di-gerbang-tol-ciawi-korlantas-kerahkan-tim-traffic-accident-analysis--1202989 (Tempo)] 

'''International relations'''
*[[Moldova–European Union relations]]
**[[2025 Moldovan energy crisis]]
***The [[European Union]] and [[Moldova]] sign an energy deal that will integrate Moldova into the bloc's [[Synchronous grid of Continental Europe|energy grid]] after [[Russia]] halted gas supplies over an alleged US$709 million unpaid bill. The [[European Commission]] says Moldova will receive €250 million ($258 million) this year to help its citizens afford rising [[electricity pricing|energy bills]] as part of the agreement. [https://apnews.com/article/eu-moldova-energy-russia-cuts-gazprom-3657d8204486044384a4b1a3b8105446 (AP)]
*[[Second Trump tariffs]]
**[[China–United States trade war]]
***The [[United States]] implements a 10% across-the-board [[tariff]] on Chinese products and eliminates the ''[[de minimis]]'' exemption for exports from China. In response, China imposes retaliatory tariffs on [[energy-related products|energy products]], [[agricultural machinery|agricultural equipment]], and [[automotive industry|automobiles]] from the United States, effective February 10, and export controls on critical minerals. It also adds U.S. companies [[PVH Corp.]] and [[Illumina Inc]] to its unreliable entities list and launches a probe into U.S. technology company [[Google]] for alleged [[competition law|anti-trust violations]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/feb/04/trump-china-tariffs (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] signs a [[presidential memorandum]] reimposing a policy of [[Maximum pressure campaign|maximum pressure]] against [[Iran]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-set-reimpose-maximum-pressure-iran-official-says-2025-02-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Risbergska school shooting]]
**Eleven people are killed and six injured in a [[mass shooting]] at the [[Campus Risbergska|Risbergska School]], a [[Komvux|municipal adult education centre]], in [[Örebro]], [[Sweden]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c206q444zx3t (BBC News)] [https://www.svt.se/nyheter/inrikes/flera-skjutna-vid-skola-i-orebro (SVT)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/feb/04/shooting-attack-sweden-orebro (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2025 New Albany, Ohio shooting]]
**Two people are killed and five others are injured after a mass shooting at a warehouse in [[New Albany, Ohio|New Albany]], [[Ohio]], United States. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/1-dead-5-injured-shooting-facility-new-albany/story?id=118474211 (ABC News)]
*[[President of Colombia|Colombian President]] [[Gustavo Petro]] calls for the worldwide [[Legal status of cocaine|legalization]] of [[cocaine]] for recreational use, saying the drug is "no worse than [[whisky]]" and that it was only illegal because it is produced in [[Latin America]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/cocaine-is-illegal-because-colombian-president-petro-proposes-cocaine-legalization/articleshow/117955103.cms (''The Times of India'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Second cabinet of Donald Trump]]
**The [[United States Senate]] confirms [[Pam Bondi]] as [[United States Attorney General|Attorney General]], making her the third female to run the [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Justice Department]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/02/04/nx-s1-5287011/pam-bondi-attorney-general-confirmation (NPR)]
*The [[United States Department of State|U.S. State Department]] orders the closure of all overseas missions of the [[United States Agency for International Development]] (USAID) and recalls thousands of USAID staff to the United States ahead of the agency's shutdown. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/state-dept-orders-shutdown-usaid-overseas-missions-recalls-staff-sources-say-2025-02-05/ (Reuters)]
